best_idea: One hit model fed by stats: effective level = level x max(100, prayer%) / 100, plus a style bonus, times (gear bonus + 64) gives a roll; max hit = (strength roll + 320) / 640; a hit lands when a random draw up to the attack roll beats a random draw up to the defence roll; damage is a random draw up to the max hit, capped at the target's hit points.
decision_why: The duel and the many-on-one fight need one roll path; this chain is short, integer and checkable. Adapt: roll on the server with a recorded seed, clamp each roll at 0, keep one clamped drain resistance, and keep the numbers as catalogue fields.
acceptance: A server test asserts max hit 11 for a level 99 accurate attacker with gear bonus 0 and 28 with bonus 100; clarity turns level 99 into effective 103; equal attack and defence rolls land about 50% over 100,000 seeded swings; a swing's damage never exceeds the target's remaining hit points.
